members.name: routing_A
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific issue is the customer writing about? Pick the option that best matches what the customer needs. If the message mentions Apple Pay, Google Pay or an Apple Watch, choose apple_pay_or_google_pay.

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment/purchase or an unknown charge appears that the customer does not recognise or did not make
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal entry appears in the app or statement that the customer did not make or does not recognise, e.g. cash they never received showing in the app, or money missing from their account as cash according to the app when they did not withdraw it
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer does not recognise or did not set up, or wants a direct debit refunded
criteria.unrecognised_incoming_money: Money appeared in the account that the customer did not put there or does not recognise
criteria.compromised_card: The customer thinks their card details or PIN were stolen, compromised, copied or used by someone else
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card is currently lost, missing or stolen (not yet found again); includes questions about fees, charges or replacements that arise because the card was lost or stolen
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The customer's phone is lost, stolen or left somewhere (e.g. left at a hotel) so they cannot use the app on it; protecting the app/account
criteria.request_refund: The customer wants a refund, wants to cancel an order or purchase and get their money back, or asks how refunds work
criteria.refund_not_showing_up: A refund from a merchant has not appeared in the account yet
criteria.charged_twice: The same payment was charged twice / duplicate charge
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A payment the customer made was cancelled or reverted (e.g. by the app), returned to the account, or has disappeared and can't be found
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash: At the ATM the machine gave less or more cash than requested, the customer did not get the cash amount they wanted, or is still waiting to receive their cash from the machine
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unidentified extra charge (often £1) on the statement that the customer does not recognise as any particular fee and asks what it is
criteria.card_fees: What the bank charges for its own cards: fees for the standard card, for ordering, replacing or getting an extra card
criteria.card_arrival: The card the customer ordered has not arrived / tracking a card in the post
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, delivery options
criteria.card_not_working: The card stopped working or does not work (general)
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM swallowed / kept / retained the card, so the customer no longer has it
criteria.change_pin: Changing or resetting the card PIN
criteria.pin_blocked: The card PIN is blocked after wrong attempts
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment in a shop/online was declined
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted, whether merchants accept it
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs the card can be used at
criteria.card_about_to_expire: The card is expiring; getting a replacement card
criteria.card_linking: Linking or adding a card to the app; also a card that was lost and has now been found again: re-adding, reactivating or still using it
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or an Apple Watch, including to top up or add funds
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a physical card, card shipping countries
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting a physical card / PIN for a new physical card
criteria.disposable_card_limits: How many times a disposable virtual card can be used, its limits
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual or disposable card does not work / is rejected
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Questions about Visa or Mastercard or which type of card the bank gives the customer: which card brand the bank issues, whether the customer can choose the card type they get, whether Visa/Mastercard can be used, what credit cards the bank carries/offers
criteria.transfer_timing: How long a transfer takes to arrive
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Sent money but the recipient has not received it
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or did not go through
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or denied, including when the customer describes their declined attempts as transfers
criteria.cancel_transfer: The customer wants to cancel a bank transfer or transaction they sent, or sent money to the wrong account (not card payments that were cancelled)
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Unable to add a beneficiary / recipient not allowed
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_transfer: A bank transfer into the account has not shown in the balance, or money seems to have disappeared from the balance with no specific unknown transaction mentioned
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_deposit: A cash or cheque deposit has not shown in the balance
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money or salary into the account, including which currencies a salary or incoming payment can be received in (not fees for receiving money)
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account / add money by bank transfer
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still pending
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal is still pending, taking too long, or not yet reflected in the balance (the balance still shows money the customer already withdrew)
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM refused the card or declined a cash withdrawal; the customer could not get cash out
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up / add money to the account with a card, including transferring money using a credit or debit card (not whether a specific kind of card is accepted)
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or was declined
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up (including a crypto top-up) was reverted or cancelled, or money put in by a top-up has disappeared
criteria.spending_limits: Daily or spending limits on the card or account (how much can be spent or moved per day)
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up / the verification code for a card top-up
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a card payment, or the customer says they were charged a fee that should not apply to them
criteria.unwarranted_fee: The customer says a fee was charged that should not apply to them (kind of fee not specified); not an unexplained extra charge on the statement
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: A fee for withdrawing cash at an ATM
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a transfer
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: A fee for topping up by card
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for receiving money or for money sent into the account by bank transfer (e.g. SEPA), including whether the full amount will arrive
criteria.fee_for_receiving_money: Asking whether they will pay a fee for receiving incoming money from someone
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate the bank uses
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A card payment abroad used the wrong exchange rate
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: A foreign cash withdrawal used the wrong exchange rate
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies the bank supports for holding and exchanging money
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Whether the bank accepts the customer's own external card for adding money: their credit card, American Express, a foreign (e.g. US) card or other cards; which kinds of external cards and currencies can be used to top up (not which card the bank issues). E.g. 'Can I top up with other cards?', 'Can I use my Amex to add money?'
criteria.verify_identity: How to verify identity, what documents are needed
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Proving the source of funds, or the customer asking where money in their account came from or who is sending it to them
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing name, address or other personal details
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank's service or cards are available in; whether people living outside the UK (e.g. in America) can sign up or get a card
criteria.cryptocurrency: Buying cryptocurrency in the app, or transfers to a crypto exchange being blocked (a crypto top-up that failed or whose money vanished is a top-up problem instead)
criteria.bank_security_info: General questions about how the bank keeps customers' money and accounts safe or protected (no specific incident)
